## Human Relations Commission Chair. NHUSD Mom. Cybersecurity Program Manager.
Deepti is the parent of a current James Logan student and a James Logan graduate. She chairs Union City's Human Relations Commission and manages cybersecurity programs and multimillion-dollar budgets at a Fortune 500 company. She is running to expand academic opportunity, follow through on campus safety, improve fiscal oversight, and make district decisions easier for the public to follow.
Meet Deepti
###### TRUSTEE AREA 5
## Do You Live in Area 5?
Trustee Area 5 covers southwest Union City, including Pioneer and Delaine Eastin Elementary Schools and the neighborhoods around Contempo Park, Pioneer Park, and Accinelli Park.
View Area 5 Map
Check Official District Lookup
###### Issues
## Priorities for a stronger New Haven Unified School District
#### Academic Opportunity
Expand access to rigorous coursework, strong programs, and excellent teaching.
#### Budget and Fiscal Responsibility
Protect classroom priorities, maintain responsible reserves, and make spending easier to follow.
#### Stronger Schools
Support strong teachers, manageable class sizes, and the resources each campus needs.
#### Transparency
Make class-size, spending, and district information easier for the public to find and understand.
#### Campus Safety
Make sure safety systems, communication, and follow-through work as intended.
View All Priorities

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: I am proud to support Deepti Garg for New Haven Unified School District Trustee. I have had the opportunity to work closely with Deepti through her service on our Human Relations Commission, where she has served with distinction for the past three years and currently serves as Chairperson. Deepti brings tremendous integrity, strong work ethic, and a genuine commitment to public service. She is thoughtful, passionate, and, most importantly, someone who looks for solutions and works hard to get things done. I have seen firsthand her dedication to our community and her ability to bring people together. I am confident Deepti will bring the same leadership, stability, and determination to the New Haven Unified School District. I believe she can help open a new chapter for our schools and make a positive difference for students, families, teachers, and our entire community. I wholeheartedly support Deepti Garg for School Board Trustee. Gary Singh, Union City Mayor

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: I appointed Deepti to Union City's Human Relations Commission in 2022 and today she chairs it. She is a proven leader. She listens before she talks, she does her homework, and she treats every neighborhood in this city like her own. Carol Dutra-Vernaci, Former Union City Mayor

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: I’m proud to endorse Deepti Garg for New Haven Unified School District Trustee, Area 5. I’m impressed by Deepti’s thoughtful and principled approach to leadership. She listens, does her research, and takes the time to understand the issues before making decisions. She leads with integrity and brings a genuine commitment to public service to everything she does. Her core values align closely with what I believe New Haven Unified School District needs: putting students first, accountability, transparency, and responsible governance. As the current Vice President of the New Haven Unified School District Board, I know how important it is to have trustees who are willing to ask questions, engage thoughtfully, and keep students at the center of their decisions. Deepti has demonstrated her commitment to public service through her work on Union City’s Human Relations Commission, where she now serves as Chair. I believe she would bring that same thoughtful, principled leadership to the New Haven Unified School District Board. I’m proud to support Deepti Garg for Trustee, Area 5. Melanie Freeberg, Vice President, New Haven Unified School District Board

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: Deepti has exactly what it takes to serve our students effectively. She will be a trusted voice our students, staff, and families deserve. Shruti Kumar, Trustee, New Haven Unified School District Board

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: Deepti’s campaign is rooted in transparency, accountability, and a genuine commitment to our community. This is a candidate who won’t just talk about change—they’ll get things done, putting students first, supporting our educators, and strengthening our schools. Prairna Gupta, Vice Chair, Union City Planning Commission

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: I strongly endorse Deepti Garg for New Haven School Board, Trustee Area 5, because her analytical background in project management is exactly what our district needs to solve complex challenges. Furthermore, her proven experience as a Human Relations Commissioner shows a deep, inclusive commitment to all our students. Martin Jequinto, Union City Human Relations Commissioner

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: Deepti Garg demonstrates the commitment to our youth and their future. Jonathan Pettey, Union City Human Relations Commissioner

images.heading: In Their Words
images.nearby: I am proud to wholeheartedly endorse Deepti for the New Haven Unified School District Board of Trustees. As a fellow Union City resident, Co-Human Relations Commissioner, and friend, I have had the privilege of working with Deepti on community initiatives. I have seen firsthand her integrity, leadership, compassion, and unwavering commitment to serving others. She is a proven leader who brings people together and always puts our community first. As a proud parent of both a current James Logan High School student and a graduate, Deepti understands the needs of our students, families, and educators. She is committed to strengthening academic excellence, improving campus safety, ensuring fiscal transparency, and making every taxpayer dollar count. Strong schools create strong communities. Deepti has the experience, vision, and dedication to help New Haven Unified School District continue to grow and succeed. I encourage everyone to join me in voting for Deepti. She is the right leader to build stronger schools, stronger families, and a stronger community. Nkechi Bridget C. Uzoegwu, Union City Human Relations Commissioner

## In Their Words
I am proud to support Deepti Garg for New Haven Unified School District Trustee. I have had the opportunity to work closely with Deepti through her service on our Human Relations Commission, where she has served with distinction for the past three years and currently serves as Chairperson.
Deepti brings tremendous integrity, strong work ethic, and a genuine commitment to public service. She is thoughtful, passionate, and, most importantly, someone who looks for solutions and works hard to get things done. I have seen firsthand her dedication to our community and her ability to bring people together.
I am confident Deepti will bring the same leadership, stability, and determination to the New Haven Unified School District. I believe she can help open a new chapter for our schools and make a positive difference for students, families, teachers, and our entire community. I wholeheartedly support Deepti Garg for School Board Trustee.
Gary Singh, Union City Mayor
I appointed Deepti to Union City's Human Relations Commission in 2022 and today she chairs it. She is a proven leader. She listens before she talks, she does her homework, and she treats every neighborhood in this city like her own.
Carol Dutra-Vernaci, Former Union City Mayor
I’m proud to endorse Deepti Garg for New Haven Unified School District Trustee, Area 5.
I’m impressed by Deepti’s thoughtful and principled approach to leadership. She listens, does her research, and takes the time to understand the issues before making decisions. She leads with integrity and brings a genuine commitment to public service to everything she does.
Her core values align closely with what I believe New Haven Unified School District needs: putting students first, accountability, transparency, and responsible governance. As the current Vice President of the New Haven Unified School District Board, I know how important it is to have trustees who are willing to ask questions, engage thoughtfully, and keep students at the center of their decisions.
Deepti has demonstrated her commitment to public service through her work on Union City’s Human Relations Commission, where she now serves as Chair. I believe she would bring that same thoughtful, principled leadership to the New Haven Unified School District Board.
I’m proud to support Deepti Garg for Trustee, Area 5.
Melanie Freeberg, Vice President, New Haven Unified School District Board
Deepti has exactly what it takes to serve our students effectively. She will be a trusted voice our students, staff, and families deserve.
Shruti Kumar, Trustee, New Haven Unified School District Board
Deepti’s campaign is rooted in transparency, accountability, and a genuine commitment to our community. This is a candidate who won’t just talk about change—they’ll get things done, putting students first, supporting our educators, and strengthening our schools.
Prairna Gupta, Vice Chair, Union City Planning Commission
I strongly endorse Deepti Garg for New Haven School Board, Trustee Area 5, because her analytical background in project management is exactly what our district needs to solve complex challenges. Furthermore, her proven experience as a Human Relations Commissioner shows a deep, inclusive commitment to all our students.
Martin Jequinto, Union City Human Relations Commissioner
Deepti Garg demonstrates the commitment to our youth and their future.
Jonathan Pettey, Union City Human Relations Commissioner
I am proud to wholeheartedly endorse Deepti for the New Haven Unified School District Board of Trustees.
As a fellow Union City resident, Co-Human Relations Commissioner, and friend, I have had the privilege of working with Deepti on community initiatives. I have seen firsthand her integrity, leadership, compassion, and unwavering commitment to serving others. She is a proven leader who brings people together and always puts our community first.
As a proud parent of both a current James Logan High School student and a graduate, Deepti understands the needs of our students, families, and educators. She is committed to strengthening academic excellence, improving campus safety, ensuring fiscal transparency, and making every taxpayer dollar count.
Strong schools create strong communities. Deepti has the experience, vision, and dedication to help New Haven Unified School District continue to grow and succeed.
I encourage everyone to join me in voting for Deepti. She is the right leader to build stronger schools, stronger families, and a stronger community.
Nkechi Bridget C. Uzoegwu, Union City Human Relations Commissioner
